response.overview: A story of an innocent poor girl, her selfish uncle made wrong use of her & sold her to a rich man for the greed of money. She kills him & barges into another wild man's house & becomes his desires victim. She then runs for safety & reaches the cops where they train her as a nurse. A rich old man who had fallen sick fell in love with her nature & hospitality & then the movie takes an unusual turn.
response.title: Pyar Ka Saudagar
